Hasan Mahmud to Rahmat Shah, FOUR, there's the century for Rahmat Shah, his 4th Test century! It has been an outstanding from the Afghan skipper. He takes his helmet off, has his hands aloft and has a beaming smile on his face. His teammates give him a standing ovation. It has been a great Test match innings. Coming back to the delivery, it was bouncer on middle. He swivelled across and nailed the pull through backward square leg to reach the milestone
Hasan Mahmud to Rahmat Shah, FOUR, sublime! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Rahmat leans towards it and creams the drive past extra cover for a gorgeous boundary
